historical_attempts.explanation: Initial 6 profiles passed but only Iran ingress carried substantial traffic. Initial threaded pressure run completed 3 passes then hit the unchanged 64-task capsule ceiling at 64 streams (cannot start new thread; pids.events max 3); the next case timed out after server failure. The batch was explicitly interrupted, remaining gates were not counted, and owned IFB/ingress cleanup was verified separately. Both server and client fixture concurrency were converted to coroutines without raising quotas. Repaired trials are separately identified, not substituted silently.

comparison_plan.question: Do finite concurrent loads, combined faults and blackout preserve application integrity?
comparison_plan.population: seven bounded paced gates;1,8,32,64 parallel TCP flows,32 with impairment,3second ingress blackout,60second mixed traffic
comparison_plan.unit: verified bytes, replies, seconds and per-gate latency
comparison_plan.derivation: exact fixture SHA and sequence verification, no throughput-capacity inference

methods.fixture: TCP fixture repeats bytes0..255, SHA256 checked per stream; UDP sequence/payload checked exactly; load generators paced; netem queue limit2000skb; no deterministic netem seed
methods.path: Iran dialer to Sofia mother-local listener, same preview.6 ELF and unchanged default capsule quotas
methods.fault: Linux netem on owned IFBs; Iran tap0 ingress src_port45100 and Sofia lo ingress dst_port45100; both directions independently verified from real counter deltas; only outer carrier TCP flows targeted
methods.scope_caveat: Rootless user-space TCP forwarding is in path; this is capsule-stack impairment, not physical full-WAN link emulation. The initial Sofia tap0 filter carried almost no traffic; v2 targets the forwarded loopback listener path and independently checks both directions using actual counters.
methods.loss_caveat: configured Bernoulli drop probability is not observed packet-loss rate; qdisc counters are packet/skb counters influenced by offloads; retransmitted traffic counted too
methods.delivery_caveat: UDP is tunneled over reliable WSS/TCP; complete delivery can coexist with large tail latency, not raw UDP loss immunity
methods.load_caveat: paced generators and changing offered aggregate loads; no unpaced maximum-capacity claim or matched direct baseline
methods.counters: per-case netem after-minus-before only; exclusion of setup/control outside these windows; blackout reported separately
methods.repeats: one trial per setting; eight HTTP requests insufficient for stable population p95
